question: The eponymous track 'Breathless' is one of the most notable works of which music artist, which was released in 1998?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shankar Mahadevan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Breathless'** is one of Shankar Mahadevan's most iconic tracks, released in **1998**, and it gained widespread recognition for its unique style.
 
• The song is composed in a way that it seems like it is sung in one continuous breath, showcasing Shankar Mahadevan's incredible vocal prowess.
 
• Shankar Mahadevan is a renowned Indian singer and composer, part of the celebrated music trio **Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy**.
 
• 'Breathless' was not only a musical masterpiece but also a breakthrough track that catapulted Shankar Mahadevan to fame in the Indian music industry.
 
• The album was produced by **Javed Akhtar**, who penned the lyrics, adding depth to the innovative composition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shankar Mahadevan** is a versatile artist who has excelled across genres such as classical, Bollywood, and contemporary music.
 
• He is a recipient of multiple awards, including **National Film Awards** for Best Male Playback Singer.
 
• Shankar Mahadevan is also known for his contributions to Indian classical music and has performed in numerous prestigious concerts worldwide.
 
• He founded the **Shankar Mahadevan Academy**, an online music school aimed at teaching Indian classical music to learners globally.
 
• The music trio **Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy**, of which Shankar Mahadevan is a part, has composed music for several blockbuster films such as **Kal Ho Naa Ho**, **Rock On**, and **Dil Chahta Hai**.
